name: cloudflare-diagram
title: CloudflareDiagram
description: Cloudflare's services on a Diagram, drawn as a statechart is: the system is a container with its name and what's account-wide, an environment a box in it, each service a card with a header (its name, its product's glyph and name) and labelled sections of chips (its handlers, triggers, settings, machine), a Worker holding its Durable Object classes, an entry marker where requests and schedules come in, and each binding an edge whose label is a card with its name on env and the operations it uses. What it knows comes from a catalog generated from Cloudflare's docs, Wrangler's schema and the Workers types: a connection can only be one the catalog says there is, and an editable card is the read-only card with dots to connect by. Editing never moves a service you didn't move (a new one goes in free room, a connection is routed between its cards where they are, places are written into the system from the first edit), and Tidy up lays it all out again as one step. What it's given is a system, which saves as JSON and reads from and writes to wrangler.jsonc, or is read from a workerd config.capnp: it says what's wrong with one, and with editable a search of the catalog adds a service and a service's machine opens in a StateDiagram. Read-only by default. Its board is also a Diagram preset, cloudflareBoardProps(system). No Cloudflare artwork. ELK and XState are optional peers.
